ruleset.description: Level 100 free-for-all using Showdown's current-generation (Gen 9) data. A species/form is eligible only if the data carries no isNonstandard marker and the form policy admits its class. Moves must have a Gen 9 source in the species' own, prevo-chain or base-form learnset. Terastallization is not modelled.
not_enforced: event-only ability/move/IV combinations (a '9S' move is rejected unless allow_event_only_moves is true; combinations are not checked)
egg-move compatibility between two egg moves, and breeding-chain restrictions
Pokemon HOME / transfer rules, shiny locks, gender locks, ball restrictions
Terastallization (tera_type is ignored with a warning; engine does not model it)
team-level clauses (species/item clauses): each combatant is validated alone
